note: No queryable zoning district service found for Oceana County MI. The county GIS Interactive Map (experience.arcgis.com viewer) uses county, municipal, drain, PLSS, parcel and hydrology layers but no zoning layer. Zoning is set by individual townships and cities: Hart city publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (2017), Pentwater Township as a PDF (July 2023), Village of Pentwater as a PDF (2021), and the Hart Township ordinance is a PDF. Searches of ArcGIS Online and Hub for Oceana zoning returned no district layer. Zoning is available only as PDF maps, so viewer-only.
